verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows ZCode connecting to Jira, Slack, Google Drive, or similar workflow tools to pull in context. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: remote invocation via WeChat, Feishu or Telegram triggers tasks rather than adding context, and a generic plugin system is shown only with an Excalidraw canvas example. No MCP or connector support is documented.

support.subject: As a developer, I can connect the agent to workflow tools like Jira, Slack, and Google Drive to extend its context
